title: Fill in the blank
description: A sentence with one or more ___ blanks, typed or picked from a word bank.

prompt.description: Text with blanks written as ___ (three or more underscores).

answers.description: One entry per blank, in order. An entry is a string or a list of accepted alternatives.

bank.description: Word bank mode: extra (wrong) words to offer. The correct words are added automatically.

ordered.description: Whether each answer must go in its own blank. Set false when the blanks can be filled in any order (a list of items); each answer still counts once.

normalize.description: Which differences to ignore when comparing a typed answer. All default to true.

whitespace.description: Collapse runs of spaces and trim.

explain.description: Shown after checking, right or wrong. Explain *why*.
